title: Rounds
description: Where a slice's rounds stand after a round or its review: the head proof judged, the builder's last commit, the verdicts, what the builder may be told of the failing cases, the findings for its next round, and the reviewer's verdicts. No field holds a line of the tests or the mark planted in them. The test writer's findings for its next round are kept packed by forge; a finding left after the last round keeps its fix only when the fix quotes no test.

stage.description: proved: the round's head is proved and its tests worktree is on disk for the review. reviewed: the review is done and nothing of the round is on disk.

done.description: No round follows: the reviewer found nothing, the builder stopped, or round 3 was reviewed.

base.description: The commit the slice was cut from, in full.

built.description: How the builder ended, as built.json gives it.

outcome.description: The slice is written in its worktree.

decisions.description: At most three decisions the builder made that the owner should know, each one short sentence. The card shows them as the builder's judgement, cut and stripped of control characters.

oneOf.description: The builder stopped, since the slice needs a capability that is not there.

outcome.description: The builder stopped before the slice was done.

decisions.description: At most three decisions the builder made that the owner should know, each one short sentence. The card shows them as the builder's judgement, cut and stripped of control characters.

missing.description: What is missing: where it would live, and its name. No sentence: the card shows the name as the builder's judgement.

lacks.description: Where the missing capability would live.

name.description: The name of the missing function, operation or action, such as worktrees.commit.

builder.description: The builder's last commit and its branch.

commit.description: The builder's last commit, in full.

head.description: The commit proof judged: the tests over the builder's last commit.

folder.description: The tests worktree, on disk only between a round and its review.

tests.description: The paths of the tests the head holds; never their text.

items.description: A verdict of proof, without its failing cases.

verdicts.description: The round's verdicts, without the checks items and without failing cases.

toBuilder.description: The reviewer's findings for the builder's next round.

toTests.description: How many findings for the test writer forge keeps packed for its next round.

conditions.description: The reviewer's last verdicts on the conditions.

items.description: A finding left after the last round, with its fix only when the fix shares no run of 20 characters with the tests.

to.description: Who the finding is for: the test writer corrects the tests, the builder the code.

case.description: A case's name, as the tests name it.

question.description: The question the case fails: Q1 to Q10 of reviewing-tests.md, negative-paths, condition, or the id of a practice given.

fix.description: The reviewer's sentence on what would fix it, left out when it shares a run of 20 characters with the tests; the card then says it is kept from the card.

remaining.description: The findings left after the last round, for the owner.

leaks.description: What forge's check found of the tests in the builder's work after the round's build: by the builder's file and kind, with counts; never a line of a test and never the mark. Any leak ends the rounds.

pinnedAtHead.description: A hash of each interface file at the round's head, or none for a file the head does not hold, read before the round's worktree is removed.

path.description: The interface file, relative to the project.

hash.description: The toolbox's short hash of the file's whole text; left out when the file is not there.

builtAt.description: The workflow step under which the builder last built; the card's lines of the builder's judgement cite it.

reviewedAt.description: The workflow step under which the reviewer last ran.

stayed.description: A branch forge asked to drop and worktrees kept, with the reason it gave; left out when every drop went through.

reason.description: worktrees.drop-branch's sentence: why the branch was kept and what would let it go.

finding.description: One finding of the reviewer, for the test writer or for the builder.

to.description: Who the finding is for: the test writer corrects the tests, the builder the code.

case.description: A case's name, as the tests name it.

question.description: The question the case fails: Q1 to Q10 of reviewing-tests.md, negative-paths, condition, or the id of a practice given.

fix.description: One sentence on what would fix it. For the builder it shares no run of 20 characters with the tests.

condition.description: The reviewer's verdict on one condition: held by which cases, or not held and why.

items.description: A case's name, as the tests name it.

why.description: One sentence on why; it shares no run of 20 characters with the tests.

failing.description: What of a failed test run the builder may be told: the failed must items, each failing case's name, its file when the slice names it, and its message only when it quotes no test; the count of messages withheld; the test files that did not load, by path only.

items.description: A failing case as the builder may be told it.

name.description: The case's name, cut at 200 characters, with no control character.

file.description: The test file, only when it is one the slice names; its path is already in the builder's task.

message.description: The first line of the runner's message, only when it shares no run of 20 characters with any test of the slice.

withheld.description: How many messages were left out because they share a run of 20 characters with a test.

notListed.description: How many more failing cases the runner counted.

notLoaded.description: The slice's test files that did not load, by path only.

leak.description: One leak: a file of the builder's that shares lines with the tests, a file that holds the mark forge planted in the kept tests, or the builder's answer holding that mark.

kind.description: The file holds lines that stand in the tests.

lines.description: How many distinct lines it shares with the tests.

kind.description: The file holds the mark planted in the kept tests.
The builder's answer holds the mark planted in the kept tests.

practices.description: What the card shows of the reviewer's last answers on the practices: how many it answered each way, each it answered not held, and how many practices a check alone holds.

tally.description: How many practices the reviewer answered held, not held and does not apply.

notHeld.description: Each practice the reviewer answered not held.

says.description: What the practice says, from its practices file.

sentence.description: The reviewer's sentence on what is wrong, only when it shares no run of 20 characters with the tests.

checks.description: How many practices of the practices files a check holds and the reviewer does not.
